purpose: Editorial review surface for portfolio content automation. Notion never holds canonical facts and never writes to the repository.
notes: Create this database manually in Notion, then paste its id into automation/config.local.json.
No database id is invented here on purpose: a wrong id would silently write review rows into an unrelated database.
Approval recorded in Notion is an editorial signal. The deterministic gate is still the approval artifact produced by scripts/approve-portfolio-proposal.mjs.

Project.description: Canonical portfolio slug, e.g. sinama. Must match data/portfolio/*.json.

Event Key.description: Deterministic idempotency key (github:<32 hex>). Unique per source event; used to find an existing row instead of creating a duplicate.

Evidence URL.description: Release, merged PR, or commit permalink the draft was derived from.

Current Copy.description: Exact current repository value for each proposed field. Read-only reference for the reviewer.

Proposed Copy.description: Gemini draft. Editable by the reviewer before approval.

Warnings.description: Validator and model warnings, including low-confidence and insufficient-evidence notes.

Approval.description: Reviewer's explicit editorial sign-off. Does not by itself authorize a write.

PR URL.description: Draft PR created after approval. Written back by the workflow.

status_flow.Detected: Meaningful event passed the deterministic filter and idempotency check.
status_flow.Drafted: Gemini returned a proposal that passed deterministic validation.
status_flow.Needs Review: Validation or model confidence requires a human decision before anything proceeds.
status_flow.Approved: Reviewer signed off. A matching approval artifact must still be generated.
status_flow.Rejected: Reviewer declined. The event key stays recorded so it is never reprocessed.
status_flow.PR Created: Draft PR opened against main. Auto-merge disabled.
status_flow.Merged: A human merged the draft PR. Terminal state.
